datasets.summary: Source diagnostic reports a 333333 candidate virtual pool, a 200 candidate working set, and ensemble surrogate trajectories.
disclosures: Surrogate oracle is an in-silico computational approximation only; no live physical battery cycling is performed.
The surrogate oracle is a frozen univariate target model: it does not model coupling between multiple measured modalities or causal process structure.
Screening timing is stage-specific: the 200-candidate diagnostic reports 2.535 seconds; the end-to-end simulation artifact reports 1.1821 seconds.
Target audit: Normalized discharge capacity at the 20th cycle (C_dis^20 / C_theoretical).
